cluster_stories.headline: TAIWAN DETAINS THREE Over Illegal AI Server Exports to China

cluster_stories.title: Taiwan Seeks to Detain Three in AI Chip Smuggling Crackdown
cluster_stories.summary: Taiwanese officials are seeking to detain three individuals for forging documents in order to export Nvidia Corp. AI chips to China, the island democracy’s first such crackdown on semiconductor smuggling.
cluster_stories.headline: TAIWAN SEIZES THREE IN NVIDIA AI CHIP SMUGGLING TO CHINA

cluster_stories.title: EU to Seek Carve-Out for Banned China Chips to Shield Auto Firms
cluster_stories.summary: The European Union will propose temporarily lifting sanctions on a Chinese semiconductor supplier after automakers warned of impending supply chain chaos if the ban isn’t removed.

cluster_stories.summary: The ban on the China-only Blackwell card landed during the Trump delegation’s state visit, on which the Nvidia CEO was a late addition. Chinese AI buyers had been using the 5090D V2 as a workaround for the H200 procurement vacuum. cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BLOCKS NVIDIA RTX 5090D During Jensen's Beijing Visit

cluster_stories.summary: The ⁠European Union has shortlisted ⁠tungsten, rare earths and ⁠gallium for its first joint stockpile of critical minerals aimed at reducing its reliance on China, according to three sources familiar with the matter. The EU is also talking to major ports ‌including Rotterdam in the Netherlands, the region’s biggest, to store the minerals, one of the three and a fourth source said. polls.description: Major AI companies are going public or raising massive funding rounds, signaling the industry's financial maturation and growth.
polls.question: Are these AI IPOs happening too early or at the right time?

cluster_stories.title: DeepSeek Founder Declares AGI Goal as $10 Billion Round Advances
cluster_stories.summary: DeepSeek’s senior management has told potential investors in its ongoing 70 billion yuan ($10 billion) funding round that the startup will prioritize groundbreaking AI research over short-term commercialization, people familiar with the matter said.
cluster_stories.headline: DEEPSEEK TARGETS AGI IN $10 BILLION FUNDING ROUND

cluster_stories.title: DeepSeek is pushing forward with $10.29 billion financing round, with Liang Wenfeng committing to continue developing open-source AI models rather than pursuing short-term commercialization goals
cluster_stories.headline: DEEPSEEK RAISES $10B, COMMITS TO OPEN-SOURCE AI

cluster_stories.title: DeepSeek founder declares AGI as the goal as $10bn funding round advances
cluster_stories.summary: Liang Wenfeng tells prospective investors the Hangzhou lab will prioritise frontier research over revenue, in its first-ever external raise. cluster_stories.headline: DEEPSEEK FOUNDER DECLARES AGI GOAL... $10BN RAISE ADVANCES

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic to Close Over $30 Billion Round as Soon as Next Week
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic PBC is set to close its latest round of funding, which may top $30 billion at a valuation above $900 billion, as soon as next week, according to people familiar with the matter, vaulting ahead of rival OpenAI to become the world’s most valuable AI startup.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC CLOSES $30B ROUND... $900B VALUATION NEXT WEEK

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic to Pay SpaceX Nearly $45 Billion for Computing Deal
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic PBC has agreed to pay Elon Musk’s SpaceX nearly $45 billion over the next three years for computing resources as part of an expanded deal to support its Claude artificial intelligence software, according to a securities filing.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC PAYS SPACEX $45B FOR COMPUTE

cluster_stories.title: SpaceX IPO Filing Reveals Anthropic Is Paying $15 Billion a Year to Access Its Data Centers
cluster_stories.summary: The long-awaited documents SpaceX filed with US regulators Wednesday included details about a lucrative deal to lend GPUs to a major AI rival.
cluster_stories.headline: SPACEX IPO REVEALS $15B ANTHROPIC DEAL
